summary: Stage 1 review passed the covered Shell AFC-18 behavior but found a major AFC-05 gap: malformed entries inside recognized dependency-audit containers are accepted as clean at exit zero. Stage 2 logic/security review was not claimed because the Stage 1 gate did not pass.
summary_markdown: See T16-review.md for spec coverage, exact repro, impact, suggested fix, evidence paths, and the Stage 2 gate decision.

acceptance.criterion: Health findings and coverage remain separate; required incomplete never PASS; supported Bun/npm formats recognized and unknown rejected.
acceptance.evidence: Required incomplete and findings/coverage tests pass, but malformed nested npm entries and reserved-container array shapes validate as recognized clean output; F-001.

acceptance.criterion: Shell help/argument errors precede credentials/session/UI mutation; actionable examples and nonzero invalid exits.
acceptance.evidence: Focused health/shell verification passes 28/28, including injected startup spies and real CLI help, typo, and missing-value subprocess cases.

acceptance.criterion: Independent Stage1 then Stage2 with concrete findings and immutable evidence; no false integrated PASS.
acceptance.evidence: Stage 1 was run first and recorded F-001; Stage 2 was explicitly blocked per review workflow.

findings.problem: Malformed values inside recognized npm dependency-audit containers are skipped, so validation returns valid and parsing yields zero findings.
findings.impact: A required dependency audit can be reported available and parsed, allowing a clean or warning gate despite malformed or unsupported audit output.
findings.suggested_fix: Reject any non-record nested npm advisory value and reject reserved npm container keys when their values have the wrong shape before using the Bun package-array fallback.
findings.evidence: src/health/sources/dependency-audit.ts:36-41 and :59-65; synthetic rc0 reproductions are recorded in T16-review.md and the review command raw artifact.

class_scope.enumeration_method: Inspected every branch of decodeAudit: npm-modern vulnerabilities, npm-legacy advisories, and the top-level Bun package-array fallback.
